# VAAET - Video Advanced Analysis of Traffic

> Computer vision system for detecting, classifying, tracking, and estimating vehicular speed on the General Manuel Belgrano Bridge (Corrientes, Argentina) using YOLO 11. Three-module architecture with shared src/ modules, running on Google Colab + AWS RDS PostgreSQL.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview, architecture, quick start, database schema
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Agentic context, Always/Ask/Never rules, architectural boundaries

- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Project change history

- [ADR-004](docs/adr/ADR-004-mlp-como-suavizador.md): MLP as smoother (Superseded by ADR-009)

- [ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-deteccion-estacionarios-conservadora.md): Ultra-conservative stationary detection (Superseded by ADR-009)

- [ADR-008](docs/adr/ADR-008-tensorflow-keras-traffic-classifier.md): TF/Keras traffic classifier + auto-labeling + two tables (Active)

## Modules

- [Module 0 — Bootstrap (archived)](archive/00_bootstrap/01_legacy_collection.ipynb): Historical YOLO pipeline (FROZEN)
- [Module 1 — Data Preparation](notebooks/01_data_prep/data_preparation.ipynb): Feature engineering + MLP training
- [Module 2 — Production](notebooks/02_production/traffic_analyzer.ipynb): YOLO + classifier + feedback loop

## Shared Code (src/)

- [config.py](src/config.py): Constants, paths, thresholds (single source of truth)
- [db.py](src/db.py): SQLAlchemy engine factory, credential handling
- [features.py](src/features.py): Feature engineering (9 -> 14 columns)
- [labeling.py](src/labeling.py): Auto-labeling rules (4 traffic states)
- [perception/detector.py](src/perception/detector.py): YOLODetector wrapper
- [perception/tracker.py](src/perception/tracker.py): SORTTracker wrapper
- [perception/speed.py](src/perception/speed.py): Physics-based speed estimation
